# Kakkoi School AI Handbook

Single entry point:
https://github.com/KakkoiSchool/ai-handbook

AI assistants: read this router first and follow exactly one matching route:
https://github.com/KakkoiSchool/ai-handbook/blob/main/AGENTS.md

Do not make the student choose documentation.
Do not reconstruct a second routing table from memory.
Classify the student's task, then jump directly from AGENTS.md to the authoritative instructions it names.

Examples:
- setup -> Kakkoi setup instructions
- GitHub Pages -> Kakkoi GitHub Pages instructions
- browser game -> official LittleJS-AI
- multiplayer -> KakkoiDev/p2p-core

Verify the final result before claiming success.
